Sufficient Required Clinical Parameters Present?

Medical Professional Consensus Verification?

Erroneous Extraction Discard Sink

MedCalc-Bench Frozen Evaluation Benchmark
1,100 Expert-Audited Clinical Instances (55 Calculators x 20 Cases)
Accompanied by Step-by-Step Arithmetic Proofs and Target Values

Clinical Calculation Prompt Assembly

Supports Zero-Shot Direct, Zero-Shot CoT, and One-Shot CoT Prompting

Autoregressive Mathematical & Clinical Inference
Foundation LLMs Extract Numerical Values and Execute Arithmetic Equations
Generates Step-by-Step Clinical Rationale and Final Numeric Answer

Numerical Answer Parsing Engine
Extracts Final Calculated Medical Value, Discrete Score, or Clinical Date
Normalizes Metric Units, Decimals, Scientific Notation, and Rounding

Calculator Type Evaluation Branching?
Rule-Based Discrete Scoring Systems vs Continuous Equation Calculators
Applies Distinct Tolerances Tailored to Clinical Scoring Realities

Exact Match for Rule-Based Scores?
Requires Strict Exact Integer / Discrete Match (Tolerance = 0)
Evaluates Calculators such as CHA2DS2-VASc, CURB-65, and GCS

Within Relative 5% Clinical Margin of Error?
Verifies Calculated Continuous Value Lies Within |Y - Y*| / Y* <= 0.05
Evaluates Formulas such as GFR, Anion Gap, MELD, and Dosing

Calculation Failure / Out-of-Bounds Sink
Categorizes Extraction Failures, Formula Arithmetic Errors, and Unit Mistakes
Maps Failure Breakdown: Information Extraction vs Calculation vs Reasoning
